title: Identifiability of phylogenetic networks and quintet concordance factors
summary: Several statistical methods of phylogenetic network inference and testing for non-tree-like relationships are based on assessing genomic data through quartet Concordance Factors, the frequencies of 4-taxon topological relationships on gene trees. While such an approach obviates making several undesirable modeling assumptions, it also results in non-identifiability issues for network roots and for small cycles.
